pressure_node_map.definition: Median line/pump-side p2 pressure per brew, rounded to nearest 0.5 bar with two documented manual corrections.
Line pressure minus fitted brewer pressure loss aQ^2+bQ+c.
Fitted brewer/pipe pressure-loss adapter between line and basket.

time_origin_map.definition: Sample after the last out-of-tolerance p2 value within the first 500 raw samples.
Midpoints 2.5-57.5 s of twelve five-second beverage fractions.
Source long-run flow used 110-120 s; Puckworks also records 100 s endpoint and 90-100 s windows.
Fixed 8.0 s source-processing assumption applied before dissolved-mass sigmoid optimization; it was not fitted and has no estimated uncertainty.

processing_and_digitization_inventory.method: Byte-exact repository pull from Zenodo-formatted data.

Puckworks re-expression of documented source reduction: pressure-bin assignment, source time alignment, 100 s truncation, unit conversion, Savitzky-Golay mass derivative, brewer subtraction, and common-grid interpolation.
processing_and_digitization_inventory.source_code_rights: Original GPLv3 producer code not ingested; committed Puckworks outputs reviewed statically.

processing_and_digitization_inventory.method: No figure digitization is used in this dossier.

rights_inventory.material: Puckworks repository and independent reimplementation code
rights_inventory.treatment: Referenced as external locked dependency; not vendored.
Scalar values, selectors, hashes, and compact statistics only; no complete dataset copied.
Minimal factual paraphrase; no article figures, tables, or long text.

missing_data_and_ambiguities.description: Rights-cleared journal-versus-preprint equation/parameter reconciliation is not available.
TDS is collected by fractions and is not matched to each pressure-trace brew.
The released processed set omits source-excluded brews without a complete dossier of identities/reasons.
Exact downstream mass/volume/dry/wet basis and instrument mapping are not frozen.
No measured temperature trace is identified; 90 degC is only the nominal viscosity reference.
d_p is folded into Q_c; discussion-scale estimate is not an input.
Variety, lot, age, moisture, and quantitative roast characterization are not recorded.
r_basket, h0, mu, and brewer quadratic uncertainties are incomplete or absent.
58 mm nominal basket and 56 mm bed/hydraulic diameter describe different geometric roles.
The 9 bar condition label is a line-pressure bin; basket pressure is separately derived and lower.
The source trace is g/s; any mL/s conversion and density basis must be frozen later.
Source alignment, TDS midpoints, and solver time zero are not yet mapped. The fixed 8.0 s source-processing offset is excluded from future solver time mapping.
Source 110-120 s long-run definition conflicts with known ended-shot contamination; Puckworks records a 100 s endpoint alternative.
No observation is frozen as a protected comparison in this dossier.
Candidate prescribed/calibration roles are proposals only.
